---
title: "Cox Proportional Hazards — Summary: `r params$target_drug`"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: false
    theme: flatly
params:
  result_files: !r character(0)
  target_drug:  "Semaglutide"
  csv_path:     "Cox_summary_table.csv"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999)  # never render numerics in scientific notation
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
# Optional project helpers (e.g. custom comma()/sig_code() wrappers). Safe to
# skip if not present -- fallbacks are defined below.
if (file.exists("helper_functions.R")) source("helper_functions.R")

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || (length(a) == 1 && is.na(a))) b else a

# Per-covariate SMD pre/post weighting, one row per original covariate (max
# abs(SMD) across derived dummies for one-hot-encoded categoricals). Prefers the
# package's own bigcbps::balance() (handles the dummy-aggregation correctly);
# falls back to the raw res$balance data.frame (covariate, smd_unw, smd_w)
# when the package isn't loaded/installed in the rendering environment.
get_balance <- function(res) {
  if (requireNamespace("bigcbps", quietly = TRUE)) {
    bal <- tryCatch(bigcbps::balance(res, aggregate = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(bal)) return(bal)
  }
  bal <- res$balance
  if (is.null(bal) || !is.data.frame(bal) || NROW(bal) == 0) return(NULL)
  smd_pre  <- if ("smd_pre"  %in% names(bal)) bal$smd_pre  else bal$smd_unw
  smd_post <- if ("smd_post" %in% names(bal)) bal$smd_post else bal$smd_w
  data.frame(covariate = bal$covariate, smd_pre = smd_pre, smd_post = smd_post,
             abs_smd_post = abs(smd_post), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Love/dumbbell plot of absolute SMD pre- vs post-weighting for one
# comparison. `bal` is the output of get_balance() (columns: covariate,
# smd_pre, smd_post). Sorted with the largest pre-weighting imbalance at
# the top; `limit` draws the SMD threshold used elsewhere in this report.
plot_love <- function(bal, label, limit = 0.1) {
  bal <- bal[order(-abs(bal$smd_pre)), , drop = FALSE]
  bal$covariate <- factor(bal$covariate, levels = rev(bal$covariate))

  pts <- rbind(
    data.frame(covariate = bal$covariate, smd = abs(bal$smd_pre),
               type = "Original SMD", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    data.frame(covariate = bal$covariate, smd = abs(bal$smd_post),
               type = "Weighted SMD", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  segs <- data.frame(covariate = bal$covariate,
                      x0 = abs(bal$smd_pre), x1 = abs(bal$smd_post))

  ggplot2::ggplot(pts, ggplot2::aes(x = smd, y = covariate)) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = segs, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                          ggplot2::aes(x = x0, xend = x1,
                                       y = covariate, yend = covariate),
                          color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(ggplot2::aes(xintercept = limit, linetype = "SMD limit"),
                        color = "#E74C3C") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = type), size = 3) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
      name   = NULL,
      values = c("Original SMD" = "#E8871E", "Weighted SMD" = "#1F4E96")
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(name = NULL, values = c("SMD limit" = "dashed")) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Absolute standard mean difference (SMD)",
                 y = "Variable",
                 title = paste0("Covariate Balance: ", label)) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right",
                  panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank())
}

if (!exists("sig_code")) {
  sig_code <- function(p) {
    ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
           ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*",
           ifelse(p < 0.1,   ".", "")))))
  }
}
```

```{r build-table}
have_results <- length(params$result_files) > 0

# Each element of params$result_files is a path to an .rds file holding a
# `bigcbps_result` object produced by bigcbps(..., family = "cox"). The
# object carries the *marginal ATE* (a survival-scale contrast over the
# fitting horizon -- e.g. RMST/risk difference, g-computation; the primary
# estimand) alongside the *conditional* log-hazard-ratio from the weighted
# Cox proportional-hazards model (secondary; NOT the ATE). See ?bigcbps and
# CBPS_IPW_DEV_PLAN.md for the distinction.
per_file <- lapply(params$result_files, function(f) {
  load(f)

  if (!inherits(res, "bigcbps_result")) {
    stop("File does not contain a bigcbps_result object: ", f, call. = FALSE)
  }
  fam <- res$spec$family %||% NA_character_
  if (!identical(fam, "cox")) {
    warning("Result file family is '", fam, "', not 'cox': ", f, call. = FALSE)
  }

  # --- Primary estimand: marginal ATE (survival-scale difference over the
  #     horizon), g-computation ---
  tau    <- res$marginal$tau    %||% NA_real_
  tau_lo <- res$marginal$ci[1]  %||% NA_real_
  tau_hi <- res$marginal$ci[2]  %||% NA_real_

  # --- Secondary: conditional log-hazard-ratio -> Hazard Ratio (absent for AIPW) ---
  cond <- res$conditional
  has_cond <- !is.null(cond) && !is.null(cond$coef) && length(cond$coef) > 0
  if (has_cond) {
    hr    <- exp(cond$coef)
    hr_lo <- exp(cond$ci[1])
    hr_hi <- exp(cond$ci[2])
    pval  <- if (isTRUE(cond$se > 0)) 2 * stats::pnorm(-abs(cond$coef / cond$se)) else NA_real_
  } else {
    hr <- hr_lo <- hr_hi <- pval <- NA_real_
  }

  # --- Validity gates: flag anything that failed and wasn't deliberately overridden ---
  gr        <- res$gate_results %||% list()
  failed    <- Filter(function(g) !isTRUE(g$passed) && !isTRUE(g$overridden), gr)
  gate_flag <- if (length(failed) == 0) "OK" else paste(names(failed), collapse = ", ")

  # --- Covariate balance: max abs(SMD) pre/post-weighting, and how many
  #     covariates remain imbalanced (abs(SMD) >= 0.1, matching the package's
  #     own summary.bigcbps_result() convention) ---
  bal <- get_balance(res)
  if (!is.null(bal) && NROW(bal) > 0) {
    max_smd_pre  <- max(abs(bal$smd_pre),  na.rm = TRUE)
    max_smd_post <- max(bal$abs_smd_post,  na.rm = TRUE)
    n_imbalanced <- sum(bal$abs_smd_post >= 0.1, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_covs       <- NROW(bal)
  } else {
    max_smd_pre <- max_smd_post <- NA_real_
    n_imbalanced <- n_covs <- NA_integer_
  }

  # --- Comparison label / metadata: pulled from spec if the caller passed
  #     custom fields through bigcbps(..., target_drug = ..., ...); falls
  #     back to the file name when absent. ---
  label <- res$spec$target_drug %||% tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  comparator <- res$spec$comparator_group %||% NA_character_
  dep_var    <- res$spec$dep_var          %||% NA_character_
  period     <- res$spec$period_name      %||% NA_character_
  # Cox-specific: the fitting horizon (in the outcome time unit, typically
  # days from index) that bounds the survival-scale marginal contrast.
  horizon    <- res$spec$horizon          %||% NA_real_
  covs       <- paste(res$covariate_names %||% character(0), collapse = ", ")

  row <- data.frame(
    Comparison         = label,
    Comparator         = comparator,
    Estimator          = toupper(res$spec$estimator %||% NA_character_),
    N                  = res$n_obs %||% NA_integer_,
    ESS_Pct            = 100 * (res$ess %||% NA_real_),
    Dependent_Variable = dep_var,
    Period             = period,
    Horizon            = horizon,
    Covariates         = covs,
    Marginal_ATE       = tau,
    Marginal_CI        = if (all(is.finite(c(tau_lo, tau_hi))))
                           paste0("(", round(tau_lo, 3), ", ", round(tau_hi, 3), ")") else NA_character_,
    Hazard_Ratio       = hr,
    HR_CI              = if (all(is.finite(c(hr_lo, hr_hi))))
                           paste0("(", round(hr_lo, 3), ", ", round(hr_hi, 3), ")") else NA_character_,
    P_Value            = pval,
    Max_SMD_Pre        = max_smd_pre,
    Max_SMD_Post       = max_smd_post,
    Imbalanced         = if (is.na(n_covs)) NA_character_
                          else paste0(n_imbalanced, " / ", n_covs),
    Gates              = gate_flag,
    stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
  )

  list(row = row, label = label, balance = bal)
})

summary_tab <- if (have_results) do.call(rbind, lapply(per_file, `[[`, "row")) else NULL
balances    <- if (have_results) setNames(lapply(per_file, `[[`, "balance"),
                                          vapply(per_file, `[[`, character(1), "label")) else list()

if (have_results) {
  # Drop identifying columns that are entirely unpopulated (no caller supplied
  # that metadata via bigcbps(...)), so the table doesn't show blank columns.
  optional_cols <- c("Comparator", "Dependent_Variable", "Period", "Horizon")
  drop_cols <- optional_cols[sapply(optional_cols, function(cn) all(is.na(summary_tab[[cn]])))]
  summary_tab <- summary_tab[, setdiff(names(summary_tab), drop_cols), drop = FALSE]
}
```

```{r export-csv}
# Export the unformatted table (raw numerics, not the display-rounded/kable
# version) so downstream consumers get full precision. Numeric columns are
# explicitly rendered in fixed (non-scientific) notation -- relying on
# options(scipen=...) alone isn't guaranteed to survive every downstream
# reader of the CSV, so we force it at write time too.
csv_written <- FALSE
if (have_results) {
  csv_tab <- summary_tab
  num_cols <- names(csv_tab)[sapply(csv_tab, is.numeric)]
  for (cn in num_cols) {
    csv_tab[[cn]] <- format(csv_tab[[cn]], scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
  }
  csv_written <- tryCatch({
    utils::write.csv(csv_tab, file = params$csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Failed to write CSV to '", params$csv_path, "': ",
            conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
    FALSE
  })
}
```

```{r render-table}
if (!have_results) {
  knitr::asis_output("_No result files provided (`params$result_files` is empty)._")
} else {
disp <- summary_tab %>%
  mutate(
    N            = comma(N),
    ESS_Pct      = paste0(round(ESS_Pct, 1), "%"),
    Marginal_ATE = round(Marginal_ATE, 3),
    Hazard_Ratio = ifelse(is.na(Hazard_Ratio), "—", round(Hazard_Ratio, 3)),
    HR_CI        = ifelse(is.na(HR_CI), "—", HR_CI),
    Sig          = sig_code(P_Value),
    P_Value      = ifelse(is.na(P_Value), "—",
                    ifelse(P_Value < 0.001, "<0.001", round(P_Value, 3))),
    Max_SMD_Pre  = ifelse(is.na(Max_SMD_Pre),  "—", round(Max_SMD_Pre, 3)),
    Max_SMD_Post = ifelse(is.na(Max_SMD_Post), "—", round(Max_SMD_Post, 3)),
    Imbalanced   = ifelse(is.na(Imbalanced), "—", Imbalanced)
  )

if ("Horizon" %in% names(disp)) {
  disp <- disp %>% mutate(Horizon = ifelse(is.na(Horizon), "—", round(Horizon, 1)))
}

rename_map <- c(
  Comparison         = "Comparison",
  Comparator         = "Comparator",
  Estimator          = "Estimator",
  N                  = "N",
  ESS_Pct            = "ESS (post-trim)",
  Dependent_Variable = "Dependent Variable",
  Period             = "Period",
  Horizon            = "Horizon",
  Covariates         = "Covariates",
  Marginal_ATE       = "Marginal ATE (surv. diff.)",
  Marginal_CI        = "95% CI (ATE)",
  Hazard_Ratio       = "Hazard Ratio (conditional)",
  HR_CI              = "95% CI (HR)",
  P_Value            = "P-Value",
  Sig                = " ",
  Max_SMD_Pre        = "Max abs(SMD) (pre)",
  Max_SMD_Post       = "Max abs(SMD) (post)",
  Imbalanced         = "Imbalanced (abs(SMD)>=0.1)",
  Gates              = "Validity Gates"
)
names(disp) <- unname(rename_map[names(disp)])

align_vec <- ifelse(sapply(disp, is.numeric), "r", "l")

kbl <- disp %>%
  knitr::kable(align = align_vec, row.names = FALSE) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
                            full_width = TRUE, font_size = 14)

gate_col <- which(names(disp) == "Validity Gates")
if (length(gate_col) == 1) {
  kbl <- kbl %>%
    kableExtra::column_spec(
      gate_col,
      color = ifelse(disp[["Validity Gates"]] == "OK", "black", "#b30000"),
      bold  = disp[["Validity Gates"]] != "OK"
    )
}

kbl %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(
    general = c(
      "Primary estimand is the marginal ATE (a survival-scale difference over the fitting horizon -- e.g. RMST/risk difference, g-computation); the Hazard Ratio is the secondary conditional log-hazard-ratio from the weighted Cox proportional-hazards model and is NOT the ATE.",
      "Hazard Ratio < 1 indicates a lower event hazard under Semaglutide treatment relative to the comparator.",
      "Horizon: the time bound (outcome time unit, typically days from index) over which the survival-scale marginal contrast is defined.",
      "Signif. codes (conditional coefficient): 0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1",
      "Max abs(SMD): largest absolute standardized mean difference across covariates, before (pre) and after (post) IPW weighting; 'Imbalanced' counts covariates with abs(SMD) >= 0.1 post-weighting, the threshold used by summary.bigcbps_result().",
      "Validity Gates: 'OK' = all gates passed; otherwise lists the failed gate name(s) (see CBPS_IPW_DEV_PLAN.md validity-gate table)."
    ),
    general_title = "",
    escape        = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Covariate Balance

```{r love-plots, results='asis'}
if (!have_results) {
  cat("_No result files provided._\n")
} else {
  plot_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "bigcbps_love_plots")
  dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  for (i in seq_along(balances)) {
    nm  <- names(balances)[i]
    bal <- balances[[i]]
    if (is.null(bal) || NROW(bal) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n_No balance data available._\n", nm))
      next
    }

    p <- plot_love(bal, nm, limit = 0.1)
    # Height scales with covariate count so labels never overlap, even at
    # the project's p ~ 30-100 upper end; width is fixed for a legend gutter.
    fig_h <- max(3, 0.35 * NROW(bal) + 1.5)
    fig_path <- file.path(plot_dir, paste0("love_", i, "_", make.names(nm), ".png"))
    ggplot2::ggsave(fig_path, p, width = 8, height = fig_h, dpi = 150, limitsize = FALSE)

    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", nm))
    cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n", fig_path))
  }
}
```
